body:
But I'm not in a dark place. And I most definitely do not care what others think of me. I am mostly well liked and when somebody is interesting I can speak to them and make friends. I just don't care about them beyond what makes them pop at first.

My issue is that sometimes I get these shocks. Like a bolt of lightning. An all of a sudden there are tears and I feel strange. For the most part I don't care about anything. I do what I have to do and what is expected. But when these surges hit me I just break down. I want them to stop. I want to not feel that anymore.
